data.title: 五和 · 晨光榻榻米被褥里的甜美依恋
data.description: 晨光洒满榻榻米被单，散发着初夜后温存的余香。五和整个人像小猫一样贴在你的怀中，小脸枕在你的臂弯里，双手紧紧搂着你的腰身，带着极致幸福的微笑安宁小憩。

data.lighting: golden morning sunlight streaming across white sheets and tatami
data.promptProse: In warm golden morning light spilling across the rumpled tatami futon, Itsuwa curls against her partner's side with her cheek resting in the crook of his arm and both hands wrapped snugly around his waist in a serene, happy doze.
data.animaCaption: Nestled closely against her partner's arm across the sunlit morning tatami futon with her bare shoulders peeking above the rumpled white sheets, she wraps both arms around his waist and rests peacefully with a blissful smile.
data.nsfwProse: Her loose white cotton wrap and tangled white sheets sit slipped down past her flushed bare shoulders and collarbones as she presses tightly against him.
